'''Hiridiu crystals''' had the capacity to boost communications signals by their mere proximity. This led to their use in many communications systems during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] also capitalized on this capacity by constructing its secret [[Outer Rim Communications Center]] near a hiridiu outcrop on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Generis/Legends|Generis]].

==Properties==
Hiridiu crystals were a form of [[Color/Legends|light blue-colored]] [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]]<ref name="CWA" /> with an unusual property: mere proximity to the crystals could boost the strength of communications signals. Consequently, the crystals were utilized in many communications systems in the period of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], signals from modern communications technology could be boosted by as much as 30 percent.<ref name="LCSB" />

==History==
A large deposit of hiridiu crystals was located on the southern pole of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Generis/Legends|Generis]], located in the [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="LCSB" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] fought between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], hiridiu crystals were used in the construction of various technological items.<ref name="CWA" /> The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] took advantage of this outcrop by constructing their secret [[Outer Rim Communications Center]], under the control of the [[Atrivis Communications Group]], near to the outcrop. This base remained under control of the Alliance's successor, the New Republic, up until the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Thrawn campaign|resurgence]] under [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]]. During the [[Fall of Generis]], the facility was captured by Imperial forces, with the loss of the uniquely efficient communications center a significant blow to the New Republic.<ref name="LCSB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hiridiu crystals were created by [[Eric S. Trautmann]] for [[West End Games]]' ''[[The Last Command Sourcebook]]'' ([[1994]]). This book provided [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] statistics for [[Timothy Zahn]]'s novel, ''[[The Last Command]]''.<ref name="LCSB" /> This information was later reprinted in ''[[The Thrawn Trilogy Sourcebook]]'', which collected the three sourcebooks written to support the [[Star Wars: The Thrawn Trilogy|''Thrawn Trilogy'']].<ref name="TTS">''[[The Thrawn Trilogy Sourcebook]]''</ref> Crystal-aided communications systems had previously been mentioned in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in ''[[Han Solo and the Lost Legacy]]'', which described [[Mytag crystal/Legends|mytag crystalline]] vertices as used in ancient [[Subspace/Legends|subspace]] communications.<ref name="HSLL">''[[Han Solo and the Lost Legacy]]''</ref> In [[2013]], hiridiu crystals were added as a common crafting material in [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']], an [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] produced by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment.<ref name="CWA" />
